meta.notes: Triggered when a human picks an angle. Stage 4 (excerpt extraction scoped to the angle) -> Stage 5 (generation, Sonnet) -> Stage 6 (Pass 1 evaluation, Opus) -> Stage 7 (revision loop, capped at 2 rounds, unrolled as three fixed blocks rather than a true n8n loop since regular nodes can't form cycles - SplitInBatches is the only looping construct n8n supports). SECRETS: Supabase API and Anthropic credentials, same as Workflow A - map both on import.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Non-secret config only. Supabase/Anthropic secrets live in n8n Credentials.

nodes.name: Count Scraped Sources
nodes.notes: Filters alwaysOutputData's placeholder before counting (Error #7). sourcesText is built here in real Code-node JS, not as inline .map/.join inside an HTTP node's {{ }} expression - scraped article text routinely contains markdown code fences (backticks), which broke the downstream Claude node's expression when spliced into a nested template literal there. A Code node evaluates real JS with actual data bindings, so arbitrary content is always safe here regardless of what characters it contains.
